subject.title: fix(agents): resolveMessagePrefix now checks channel and account messagePrefix configs

question: Should this PR intentionally start honoring existing channel/account WhatsApp `messagePrefix` settings for inbound agent text?
rationale: The code is a narrow bug fix, but it changes upgrade behavior for stored configs whose channel/account prefixes were previously ignored.

options.title: Accept Corrected Precedence
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI, treating the stored-config behavior change as the intended fix for the existing config surface.

options.title: Hold For Upgrade Guidance
options.body: Ask for a small PR-body or docs note if maintainers want explicit user-facing guidance before enabling the corrected precedence.

recommendation.title: Accept Corrected Precedence
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI, treating the stored-config behavior change as the intended fix for the existing config surface.
